# Clairson

> Clairson helps UK letting and estate agents get found and recommended by AI assistants: ChatGPT, Google AI (AI Overviews and Gemini), Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity. Founded by Isreal Jackson, based in Milton Keynes, working across the UK.

- Standard plan: full AI visibility audit (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Copilot); Google Business Profile, Bing Places and Apple Business Connect set up and optimised; directory clean-up so name, address and phone match everywhere; website FAQs and structured data written for AI; review request system; monthly AI visibility report.
- Premium plan: everything in Standard, plus local press releases and pitching to local news; data-led local property stories with the agent quoted as the expert; monthly competitor tracking; fortnightly reports and a monthly strategy call; priority support.
- Prices: free 15-minute AI visibility check. Standard £500 setup in month 1, then £199 a month. Premium £1,200 setup, then £349 a month. Three-month minimum. Founding offer for the first three clients: Standard setup for £345, then £199 a month.
- Honest promise: we improve and track how AI sees an agency; no one can guarantee an AI will name them first.
- Contact: 07537 175345 (phone and WhatsApp), clairson.uk@gmail.com

## Research
- [Which letting agents does AI recommend in Milton Keynes? (31 Oct 2026)](https://clairson-uk.github.io/research/milton-keynes-ai-recommendations/): ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, Copilot Search and Perplexity named 38 different agencies across 12 answers; only Prestige Estates MK, Lion Estates and Alexander Lawrence were named by all four.
